ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character.? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character..

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Cheating in exams

3. Which response best shows understanding of Wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Say Wudhu has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Wudhu to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Wudhu with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wudhu.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Swalah? (1 mark)

   B. Say Pillars of Swalah has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Pillars of Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Swalah.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on brushing teeth? (1 mark)

   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on brushing teeth with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on brushing teeth.
   D. Use Hadith on brushing teeth to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara Types of Najasaat? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara Types of Najasaat.
   B. Apply the teaching of Twahara Types of Najasaat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Twahara Types of Najasaat to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Twahara Types of Najasaat has no place in daily life.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

8. Which response best shows understanding of Conditions for Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Conditions for Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Conditions for Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Conditions for Swalah.
   D. Say Conditions for Swalah has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru.
   B. Use Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru has no place in daily life.

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

11. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on Etiquette of Eating has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hadith on Etiquette of Eating to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Etiquette of Eating.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Angels Atid,? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in Angels Atid, has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Angels Atid,.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in Angels Atid, with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Belief in Angels Atid, to insult classmates of other faiths.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surahs? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Surahs with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surahs.
   C. Say Selected Surahs has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Selected Surahs to insult classmates of other faiths.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Attributes of Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Attributes of Allah.
   B. Say Attributes of Allah has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Attributes of Allah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Attributes of Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Fitness? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on Fitness has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hadith on Fitness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Fitness.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Fitness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on Etiquette of Eating and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
